description: Antigravity CLI (agy) 1.5.9 sanitized hooks.json sample. Standalone hooks live at <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json and ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json; plugin hooks must sit at the plugin root (hooks/hooks.json is only staged there when importing Gemini/Claude extensions and is not read for native plugins). Verified on the remote 1.5.9 machine: the hooks manager loads all roots headless before sign-in (log line 'loaded N named hooks from M hooks.json file(s)'). Schema per builtin docs/hooks.md: top-level keys are hook names; events SessionStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PreInvocation/PostInvocation/Stop; tool events use grouped {matcher, hooks[]} with a regex matcher; handler objects are {type:'command', command, timeout?} with JSON stdin/stdout contracts (camelCase protojson payloads).
